title: Princess of the Pumpkin Patch
author: Lerastudio
description:
You get 4 individual files. These files are files in svg, dxf, eps, ai, png formats. They are packed in a zip archive. The Zip File is needs to be extracted.
These cliparts perfect for invitations, party announcements, printed invitations, greeting cards, web graphics, digital scrapbooking, and much more.
You can cut them on any cutting machine. Just be sure your cutting machine and software are compatible.
If you would like the files in another format or if you have any further questions, please do not hesitate to ask!
